categories.name: Essential
categories.tagline: Chats, email, calendar, reminders, memory and safety rails.

categories.name: Productivity
categories.tagline: Optional: voice, focus, planning and life admin.

categories.name: Builder
categories.tagline: Optional: coding agents, jobs, previews and modules.

features.name: Lives in WhatsApp
features.description: Its own WhatsApp number, in DMs and groups. Telegram too.

features.name: Per-chat permissions
features.description: Each chat gets a tier: read, ask, write or admin.

features.name: Approve before anything goes out
features.description: Messages, emails and invites are drafts until you say yes.

features.name: Owner passphrase
features.description: Prove it's you from a new device with a passphrase.

features.name: Understands voice notes
features.description: Voice notes transcribed locally and handled like text.

features.name: Long-term memory
features.description: Remembers facts, preferences and promises across chats.

features.name: Listening notes
features.description: Running notes of decisions, deadlines and action items.

features.name: Reminders that ring
features.description: Natural-language reminders that nag, mirrored to Apple Reminders.

features.name: Smart follow-ups
features.description: Pings them later only if nobody replied.

features.name: Promise tracker
features.description: Every promise and request, across all chats, in one list.

features.name: Calendar
features.description: See your day, find free slots, create events.

features.name: Morning digest
features.description: A morning brief of calendar, reminders and key email.

features.name: Email triage and drafts
features.description: Surfaces important email and drafts replies in your voice.

features.name: Secrets vault
features.description: Passwords via one-time link; Vision uses them unseen.

features.name: Live dashboard
features.description: Private web dashboard for jobs, reminders, memory and earnings.

features.name: Kill switch
features.description: Say 'stop everything' and all agents halt.

features.name: Desktop and web app
features.description: A chat app with module panels, for Mac and web.

features.name: One-click install
features.description: Download, sign in, link WhatsApp. No terminal.

features.name: Email & Calendar
features.description: Read your inbox and calendar, write drafts. Nothing is ever sent without your explicit approval.

features.name: Memory
features.description: Long-term notes the assistant can remember, search and forget. Stored locally.

features.name: Reminders
features.description: Local reminders with natural times ('in 2h', 'tomorrow 9am'). Notifications stay on this device.

features.name: Vault
features.description: Encrypted local secret store (AES-256-GCM). Secret values are never returned to chat.

features.name: WhatsApp
features.description: Link your WhatsApp (and optionally a second bot number) by QR or pairing code. Replies are drafts until you approve them.

features.name: Replies with voice
features.description: Spoken replies as voice notes, generated on-device.

features.name: Smart speaker
features.description: Talk to Vision through an Echo speaker.

features.name: Voice from the dashboard
features.description: Hold to talk in the browser; hear answers aloud.

features.name: People graph
features.description: A private map of who you know, from your notes.

features.name: Day planner
features.description: Turn a rough schedule into calendar blocks.

features.name: OTP and alert relay
features.description: Forwards codes and urgent alerts to a private chat.

features.name: Send as you, with approval
features.description: Drafts from your number; reply 'send' to release.

features.name: Tunnel Vision
features.description: Commit to 1–3 tasks; distracting apps blocked until done.

features.name: Leisure breaks
features.description: Take a real break; new work waits.

features.name: Activity log
features.description: A private movement log synced from your watch.

features.name: Apple Watch app
features.description: A small watch app that syncs activity.

features.name: Mac control app
features.description: Steer Vision from the Mac menu bar.

features.name: Canvas Learning
features.description: Read-only Canvas LMS: courses, assignments, grades, deadlines and a study planner.

features.name: Focus
features.description: Timed focus sessions with a log, and an end-of-session reminder.

features.name: Client-friendly groups
features.description: Plain-English status answers for clients, no internals.

features.name: Bring your own engine
features.description: Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, switchable per chat or job.

features.name: Coding pipeline
features.description: Describe a change; parallel agents build it and open a PR.

features.name: Background jobs
features.description: Long tasks run in the background and report back.

features.name: Work pool autopilot
features.description: A prioritised backlog with capped, balanced parallel jobs.

features.name: Previews and prototypes
features.description: Preview links and quick prototypes of work in progress.

features.name: Many parallel sessions
features.description: Per-project sessions that hand off and report to each other.

features.name: Mini pages
features.description: Long answers become clean mobile pages.

features.name: Uses your browser
features.description: Drives your logged-in Chrome and takes notes on calls.

features.name: Connectors
features.description: Gmail, Drive, Figma, Canva, Vercel, Supabase and more.

features.name: Designs and decks
features.description: Mockups, posters and decks as editable links.

features.name: Build your own Vision
features.description: Pick what you need; the app builds itself around it.

features.name: Module catalog
features.description: Browse and add community modules.

features.name: Hosted Vision
features.description: Run Vision in the cloud instead of your Mac.

features.name: Coding
features.description: Plan coding tasks, run parallel agent sessions in git worktrees, and open PRs after approval. Never merges.
